P_0x001CA9: Desert-raised surface dweller, pilot of the Elemental Soulgady. Finds his place only in battle, yet seeks peace his own way. Skilled at gathering intel; sometimes acts alone for it.
P_0x002CE3: A demon priest of the destruction god Sarva Volkruss. Polite but cold and merciless. Works with Shu to prep Volkruss's revival.
P_0x008A4B: AI researcher who built "AI-0," a high-performance combat AI. Ex-instructor at the Federation Army officers' academy; Aqua Centrum was her student.
P_0x00A3C2: A Gaia Sabers scientist. Studied <Aerogater> materials at <DC>, then used the data to develop metal cells called <Machine Cell>. Also built the <Geim System>.
P_0x00CFED: Brilliant scientist, ex-<EOTI Organization>, now builds weapons for Zentl Project. Also designed the Granzon.
U_0x0171A6: A highly mobile wind <Elemental> built for hit-and-run. Standard armament trails other <Elemental>s, so weak pilots can't unlock its full power. Output is stable and its spirit accepts nearly any pilot - hence the mass-produced Gadyful. Its spirit is Soleid of the Sandstorm, a low-rank wind spirit.
U_0x0054BB: Third unit (SRG-03-3) of the newest Grungusts, from the <Tesla Leicht Institute> under the <SRX Project>, unfrozen after the <L5 Campaign>. Based on Grungust (Type-1), specialized for melee, with the series' top output and attack power. Splits into G-Raptor fighter (upper body) and G-Bison tank (lower body), one pilot each. After the <Inspector Incident>, it gained the <T-LINK System>, a <Tesla Drive>, and the Type-3 Shishioh Blade (<S.Unit>-size).
U_0x00B4DF: Lion's successor from <Isurugi Heavy Ind.>; 'Relion' = 'Refined Lion.' Human-type arms wield varied weapons like the Guarlion. A multirole <Armored Module>: stronger, easier to handle, maintain, and build than the Lion.
